<?php
/* A page cache: reads ONE request key, keeps its files in the temp dir, and
   includes the cached copy by variable. Never writes from the request. */
$page = isset( $_GET['page'] ) ? (int) $_GET['page'] : 1;
$file = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/cache-' . md5( (string) $page ) . '.html';
if ( is_readable( $file ) ) {
    readfile( $file );
    return;
}
$template = __DIR__ . '/templates/list.php';
include $template;
